title: Neutron Albedo Mapping: Finding Hidden Water on the Moon (2026)
description:
Most people think the Moon is dry. They are wrong. This video explains how neutron albedo mapping detects hydrogen trapped in permanently shadowed craters. We break down the physics of neutron moderation and why this data is critical for future lunar bases. Watch to see how invisible water becomes visible through cosmic ray interactions.

#MoonWater #NeutronAlbedo #SpaceScience #LunarExploration #Astronomy
